title: Design System: Fantasy Basketball Draft Room

display.purpose: Responsive page titles; the only large type role.

headline.purpose: Anchors dense panel regions without competing with the page title.

body.purpose: Controls, supporting copy, and evidence explanations.

navigation.purpose: Primary navigation items in the fixed or drawer rail.

label.purpose: Uppercase context, field, and table labels.

data.purpose: Comparable prices, ranks, scores, budgets, and metrics.

mono.purpose: Inline and block code inside Eve responses.

shadows.name: signal-focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Reinforces the orange focus border on active fields and the Eve composer; never used as ambient elevation.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Panel movement and one-pixel button press feedback.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Color, border, opacity, and short interaction transitions.

motion.name: duration-panel
motion.purpose: Eve rail and mobile navigation movement.

motion.name: processing-pulse
motion.purpose: The compact Eve analyzing-state dot only.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The current decisive action; use once per immediate decision context.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-signal); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--color-signal); color: var(--color-canvas-deep); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 750; transition: border-color var(--duration-fast) ease, background-color var(--duration-fast) ease, color var(--duration-fast) ease, transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out); } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--color-signal-soft); background: var(--color-signal-soft); } .ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-signal); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.45; }

components.name: Secondary Control
components.description: A quiet navy control for supporting actions that must not compete with the decision signal.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--color-surface-2); color: var(--color-ink-muted); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 750; transition: border-color var(--duration-fast) ease, background-color var(--duration-fast) ease, color var(--duration-fast) ease, transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out); } .ds-button-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--color-brand-navy); background: var(--color-surface-3); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-button-secondary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-signal); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-secondary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.45; }

components.name: Primary Navigation Item
components.description: Grouped rail navigation with a tonal hover and an orange current-page dot.
components.html: PlayersDraft
components.css: .ds-nav { padding: 18px 12px; background: var(--color-canvas-deep); font-family: var(--font-ui); } .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-md); color: var(--color-ink-muted); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 620; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--color-surface-1); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current='page'] { border-color: var(--color-brand-navy); background: var(--color-brand-navy); color: var(--color-brand-white); } .ds-nav-item > span { display: grid; width: 25px; height: 25px; place-items: center; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: rgb(var(--color-brand-gray-rgb) / 0.08); color: currentColor; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current='page']::after { position: absolute; right: 9px; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-signal); content: ''; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-signal); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Statistic Card
components.description: A compact metric tile for the decisive evidence row.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { padding: 14px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--color-surface-2); font-family: var(--font-ui); } .ds-stat-card span { display: block; color: var(--color-ink-subtle); font-size: 0.65rem; } .ds-stat-card strong { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--color-ink); font-size: 1.28rem; letter-spacing: -0.03em; }

components.name: Labeled Field
components.description: The standard compact field for filters, scenario inputs, and live-draft controls.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; min-width: 160px; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: var(--font-ui); } .ds-field > span { color: var(--color-ink-subtle); font-size: 0.6rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { min-width: 0; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong); border-radius: 8px; outline: none; background: var(--color-surface-1); color: var(--color-ink-muted); font: inherit; font-size: 0.72rem; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-subtle); opacity: 1; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--color-signal); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(var(--color-brand-orange-rgb) / 0.1); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-signal); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A text-plus-dot state marker; orange is attention and green is verified readiness.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 4px 7px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--color-brand-gray-rgb) / 0.18); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--color-ink-muted); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.6rem; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-badge::before { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-signal); content: ''; } .ds-status-ready::before { background: var(--color-success); }

components.name: Evidence Caveat
components.description: A restrained warning container for inferred, incomplete, or unavailable evidence.
components.html: Evidence noteRoster activity is inferred from daily snapshots, not a confirmed transaction ledger.
components.css: .ds-warning { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 15px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--color-brand-orange-rgb) / 0.2); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: rgb(var(--color-brand-orange-rgb) / 0.07); color: var(--color-ink-muted); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.7rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-warning strong { flex: none; color: var(--color-ink-muted); }

components.name: Eve Composer
components.description: The spatially stable analyst input with the same field and decision-action grammar as the workspace.
components.css: .ds-composer { padding: 12px 14px 16px; border-top: 1px solid rgb(var(--color-brand-gray-rgb) / 0.11); font-family: var(--font-ui); } .ds-composer > label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); } .ds-composer > div { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; } .ds-composer textarea { min-height: 46px; flex: 1; resize: none; padding: 10px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong); border-radius: 10px; outline: none; background: var(--color-canvas); color: var(--color-ink); font: inherit; font-size: 0.72rem; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-composer textarea:focus { border-color: var(--color-signal); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(var(--color-brand-orange-rgb) / 0.1); } .ds-composer button { padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--color-signal); color: var(--color-canvas-deep); font: inherit; font-weight: 800; } .ds-composer textarea:focus-visible, .ds-composer button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-signal); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-live-decision { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--color-brand-gray-rgb) / 0.13); border-radius: 12px; background: rgb(0 18 37 / 0.46); font-family: var(--font-ui); } .ds-live-hero { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-live-hero > div { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-live-hero > div > strong { color: var(--color-ink); font-size: 1rem; } .ds-live-hero small { color: var(--color-ink-subtle); font-size: 0.66rem; } .ds-live-action { min-width: 92px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 850; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-live-caution { color: var(--color-signal); } .ds-live-metrics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; margin: 15px 0 0; } .ds-live-metrics div { padding: 10px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--color-brand-gray-rgb) / 0.09); border-radius: 8px; background: rgb(0 26 53 / 0.65); } .ds-live-metrics dt { color: var(--color-ink-subtle); font-size: 0.58rem; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-live-metrics dd { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--color-ink-muted); font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-live-judgment { margin: 12px 0 0; padding: 10px 11px; border-left: 1px solid var(--color-signal); background: rgb(var(--color-brand-orange-rgb) / 0.05); color: var(--color-ink-subtle); font-size: 0.64rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-live-judgment span { margin-right: 7px; color: var(--color-signal); font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.css: .ds-player { border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-surface-1); color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-ui); } .ds-player summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-player summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-player summary:hover { background: var(--color-surface-2); border-radius: 12px; } .ds-player summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-signal); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-player summary strong { display: block; font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-player summary small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--color-ink-muted); font-size: 0.68rem; } .ds-player-initials { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: 0 0 38px; height: 44px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-surface-3); color: var(--color-ink-muted); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-player-detail { padding: 0 16px 16px; color: var(--color-ink-muted); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-player-measure { padding: 8px 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line); color: var(--color-ink-muted); font-size: 0.65rem; } .ds-player-measure strong { color: var(--color-ink); font-size: 0.9rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-read { position: relative; display: inline-flex; font-family: var(--font-ui); } .ds-read button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 32px; padding: 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; color: var(--color-ink-muted); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-read button:hover, .ds-read button:focus-visible { color: var(--color-signal-soft); background: var(--color-surface-3); } .ds-read button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-signal); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-read svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-read-tip { display: none; position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 0; z-index: 100; width: 200px; max-width: 70vw; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-canvas-deep); color: var(--color-ink-muted); font-size: 0.72rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-read:hover .ds-read-tip, .ds-read:focus-within .ds-read-tip { display: block; } .ds-read-tip strong { display: block; color: var(--color-ink); margin-bottom: 4px; } @media (max-width: 680px) { .ds-read button { width: 36px; height: 40px; } }

narrative.overview:
The Draft Room is a continuous navy instrument frame for making evidence-backed decisions under pressure. Its product grammar is dark, compact, and operational: a restrained adaptation of Linear's structural clarity, not a copy of its marketing language or visual identity. League research, live decisions, and Eve all occupy the same composed field so the owner never loses context when moving from evidence to judgment.

The visual system earns confidence through stable geometry, dense but legible information, and explicit evidence states. Matte tonal layers and hairline rules establish hierarchy without turning each dataset into a floating card. Orange is deliberately scarce; it identifies an active, selected, or decisive moment, while white carries primary information and cool gray carries provenance, metadata, and uncertainty.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous matte-navy frame with a narrow navigation rail, broad evidence workspace, and spatially stable Eve rail.
Compact neutral typography, tight tracking, and tabular numerals for scan-heavy league evidence.
Tonal depth and hairline borders instead of ambient shadows, glow, gradients, or a white SaaS card grid.
Restrained orange decision signals, with labeled semantic colors for player evidence and projection tiers.
Evidence caveats remain visible wherever data is inferred, incomplete, unavailable, or degraded.

rules.name: The One Navy Family Rule
rules.body: Blue surfaces stay inside the Court Navy tonal family. Evidence Blue is reserved for compact labeled player signals.

rules.name: The Decision Signal Rule
rules.body: Draft Orange appears at active, selected, focused, or decisive moments. It must not become ambient decoration or a general-purpose fill.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Semantic color describes a labeled state, model estimate, or projection rank band, never decorative mood. Missing evidence stays neutral; model-estimated durability is not live injury clearance.

rules.name: The No Hero Type Rule
rules.body: Operative screens begin with a clear page title, not a marketing headline; display type never overwhelms the evidence below it.

rules.name: The Tabular Evidence Rule
rules.body: Prices, ranks, budgets, scores, and rule values use tabular numerals whenever they appear in columns or changing readouts.

rules.name: The Stable Frame Rule
rules.body: Eve joins or overlays the instrument frame without reordering navigation or displacing the owner's current evidence context.

rules.name: The Dense, Not Cramped Rule
rules.body: Use the established spacing rhythm and clear tonal grouping; do not enlarge controls or add whitespace merely to make the interface feel simpler.

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Rule
rules.body: Surfaces remain shadowless at rest; use tonal steps and hairlines for structure, and reserve the focus halo for keyboard or text-entry focus.

rules.name: The Radius Follows Scope Rule
rules.body: The larger the information region, the larger its established corner step; do not use oversized rounding to make dense analytical panels feel playful.

dos: Do preserve one continuous navy operating field across navigation, evidence, and Eve.
Do reserve Draft Orange for the current action, active state, focus, rank, or decisive evidence signal.
Do label facts, projections, inferences, unavailable evidence, and degraded AI states in visible language.
Do use tabular numerals and stable metric geometry for values that change or must be compared.
Do keep the owner spatially oriented when Eve opens, closes, streams, fails, or resumes.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glow, ambient card shadows, a white SaaS canvas, or an unrelated blue accent.
Don't spread orange across passive decoration or multiple competing calls to action.
Don't turn every dataset into an isolated floating card or trade scan density for ornamental whitespace.
Don't use color alone to communicate readiness, risk, failure, or evidence quality.
Don't present inferred roster activity, historical prices, projections, or Eve output as authoritative fact without its caveat.
